omission-classes.title: An environmental input-domain was silently dropped
omission-classes.description: A domain in the environmental dimension (deploy / interrupt / locale / network) was declared in the manifest but is absent from both the AT-covered surface AND the `## NOT covered` table.

omission-classes.title: A behavioural state or transition was silently dropped
omission-classes.description: A state-machine state, transition, or invariant on the SUT was declared in the manifest but is absent from both the AT-covered surface AND the `## NOT covered` table.

omission-classes.title: A process mode-flag combination was silently dropped
omission-classes.description: A decision-table row / mode-flag cartesian cell was declared in the manifest but is absent from both the AT-covered surface AND the `## NOT covered` table.

omission-classes.title: A negative or robustness domain was silently dropped
omission-classes.description: A negative-input domain (malformed input / boundary / overflow) or a robustness domain (concurrent stressor / partial-failure path) was declared in the manifest but is absent from both the AT-covered surface AND the `## NOT covered` table.

omission-classes.title: A known residue was not carried forward
omission-classes.description: A `## Known residues carried forward` entry from a prior signoff was silently dropped on the current signoff -- the residue does not appear, but its owner-bound exit criterion was not satisfied.

omission-classes.title: A not-applicable marker shipped without the human attestation
omission-classes.description: The manifest carries a `not-applicable` marker (state-C, §4.2) but the `## Signoff` block omits the `manifest-not-applicable-attested: <human> <date>` line -- a state-C escape MUST carry an explicit human co-sign (neither brick nor bypass).
